name: Hillsbrad Town Registry
summary: In Hillsbrad Fields, the town hall keeps the names and land rights of those who remain. The Hillsbrad Town Registry records the town's civic order, and the Forsaken seek it as they attack the human stronghold.

sections.title: A Record of Defiance
sections.body:
The Hillsbrad Town Registry holds the town's names and rights. It lies in the town hall near Magistrate Burnside's podium. From Tarren Mill, the Forsaken press to break human resistance in the foothills. Darthalia sends Horde champions into the hall to kill the council and seize the ledger.

Its pages record Hillsbrad's population, households, and administrative rights. The Forsaken would use them to undo the town's civic order and learn about its surviving people and their assets.

faq.q: Where is the Hillsbrad Town Registry kept?
faq.answer: The Hillsbrad Town Registry is kept in a corner of the town hall in Hillsbrad Fields, near the stairs to Magistrate Burnside's platform.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want to steal it?
faq.answer: High Executor Darthalia seeks to dismantle human rule in the foothills. The registry records the town's citizens, households, administrative rights, and property, giving the Forsaken knowledge of the surviving community.
Magistrate Burnside and the Hillsbrad Councilmen guard the registry. They wield defensive magic and rally inside and around the town hall.

angles.text: For the Horde, taking the town registry helps break human authority in the foothills and secure the Forsaken stronghold at Tarren Mill.
As a human, you can see the ledger records the formal existence and rights of Hillsbrad's remaining townsfolk. Its loss would strike the regional community hard.
